statement: For G=(F_3^2,+), there is no coefficient function a:G->{0,1,-1} with exactly eight nonzero values such that D D^(-1)=7[0]+sum_{x in G}[x], where D=sum_{x in G} a_x[x]. Equivalently, SDS(9,8,1,C_3^2) does not exist.
contribution: A complete full-scope nonexistence proof for the frozen group-specific case. The principal character and exact translation/global-sign normalizations reduce every assignment to two negative nonzero positions. They are either opposite, when a selected nonprincipal character has norm 25, or independent, when a selected nonprincipal character has norm 13; both contradict the required norm 7. Independent exact enumeration audits all 2304 raw assignments and the two GL(2,3) orbits. A bounded current primary-source search found no later stated resolution, but no unrestricted priority claim is made.
